EC2: Any history of receiving GLP-1 analogues [OR] or dipeptidyl peptidase inhibitors within 6 months
EC3: Known severe heart failure, classified as NYHA 4.
EC4: Active myocarditis [OR]; malfunctioning artificial heart valve.
EC5: History of ventricular tachycardia [OR] within 3 months before study entry; second- [OR] or third-degree atrioventricular block.
EC6: Supine systolic blood pressure <85 mm Hg [OR] or >200 mm Hg at screening.
EC7: Primary renal impairment [AND], creatinine clearance < 45 ml/min if treated with metformin.
EC8: Uncorrected hypokalemia [OR] or hyperkalemia (potassium <3.5 mmol/l [OR] or >5.5 mmol/l).
EC10: Severe gastrointestinal disease, including gastroparesis. As judged by the Investigator.
EC12: Malignant neoplasm requiring chemotherapy [OR], surgery [OR], radiation [OR] or palliative therapy in the previous 5 years. Patients with [NOT] intraepithelial squamous cell car [OR]cinoma of the skin treated with topical 5FU and subjects with basal cell skin cancer are allowed to enter the trial.
EC13: Females of child bearing potential who are pregnant, breast-feeding or intend to become pregnant.
EC15: History of acute [OR] or chronic pancreatitis
EC16: Subjects considered by the Investigator to be unsuitable for the study.
